preconditions: Install the checked-in diagnostic app on a clean dedicated simulator before timing; its in-memory order starts empty when launched.

checkpoints.goal: Sample Shop visibly shows Apple selected in the order.

assertions.claim: The selection summary reads Selected: Apple.

checkpoints.goal: Sample Shop visibly shows Apple and Bread selected in the order.

assertions.claim: The selection summary reads Selected: Apple, Bread.

checkpoints.goal: The Order complete confirmation for Apple and Bread is visible.

assertions.claim: The Order complete confirmation screen is visible.
